mohāropanaka: [Moha+āropanaka] (ti) CL=7 A cause for rising up to a state of delusion.
mohāropanakamma: [Mohāropana+kamma] (na) CL=7 Kamma that rises up to a state of delusion.  Mohāropanakamma.
mohūpanissayappahāna: [Mohūpanissaya+pahāna] (na) CL=7 Rejects the cause of strong delusion (Dava).
mokkha: [Muca+ta] (pu) CL=7 [Mokkha+a. Mucamocane, hīnamajjhamatāvehi muccatīti mokkho, to, tassa kho, mokkha mocane vā, a. Dhāna,ṭī.696. Muccanti ettha, etena vā rāgādītīti mokkho. Dhāna,ṭī.6.] (1) Liberation. (2) To be set free. (3) Nibbāna. (4) Conclusion. The end. Completely liberate. The final destination. Liberation from the cycle of life. (5) Noble. Prescribed. See original.
mokkhacikā: [Mokkha+ci+ṇvu+ā] (thī) CL=7 [Hatthapādānaṃ mokkhena mocanena cayati parivattati etāyāti mokkhacikā. Sī,ṭī,saca,1.362.]  Playing back and forth. Somersault as a fun. Rolling.
mokkhadhamma: [Mokkha+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 The Dhamma is liberation from (such as the cycle of life). Nibbāna.
mokkhadhammadesaka: [Mokkhadhamma+desaka] (ti) CL=7 One who teaches dhamma to attain Nibbāna.
mokkhadhammagavesana: [Mokkhadhamma+gavesana] (na) CL=7 Acquired the Nibbāna dhamma that is liberation from the cycle of life.
mokkhagavesī: [Mokkha+gavesī] (ti) CL=7 One who acquires the cause of liberation.
mokkhamagga: [Mokkha+magga] (pu) CL=7 The path that leads to Nibbāna. Nibbāna path.
mokkhamaggagamana: [Mokkhamagga+gamana] (na) CL=7 Going to the path of Nibbāna.
mokkhamaggatti: [Mokkha+patti] (thī) CL=7 Attains Nibbāna. Attains Magga, Phala, Nibbāna.
mokkhamaggācariya: [Mokkhamagga+ācariya] (pu) CL=7 The teacher that leads or guides the path to Nibbāna.
mokkhamaggāvaraṇa: [Mokkhamagga+āvaraṇa] (na) CL=7 Blocking the path to Nibbāna. Blocking Ariyāmagga that is the path to Nibbāna.
mokkhantarāya: [Mokkha+antarāya] (pu) CL=7 The danger (blocking) for attaining Nibbāna.
mokkhantarāyika: [Mokkhantarāya+ika] (ti) CL=7 That is a danger (blocking) for attaining Nibbāna.
mokkhapuradvāra: [Mokkhapura+dvāra] (ti) CL=7 A person who is like the gate of a Palace.
mokkhasampāpaka: [Mokkha+sampāpaka] (ti) CL=7 That leads to Nibbāna. A cause of attaining Nibbāna.
mokkhasi: [Muca+ssasi] (kri) CL=7 You will liberate. See - Mokkhati-(2).
mokkhasukha: [Mokkha+sukha] (na) CL=7 The peace and tranquility of Nibbāna.
mokkhati: [Mokkha+a+ti.nīti,dhā.21.] (kri) CL=7 He is liberated. Mokkhati(kri) [muca+ssati.nirutti,nyā.438.] He will liberate.
mokkhābhimukha: [Mokkha+abhimukha] (ti) CL=7 Looking forward to Nibbāna or aim to attain Nibbāna.
mokkhādhigamanaṭṭha: [Mokkhādhigamana+attha] (ti) CL=7 That has the benefit which is completely liberated.
mokkhādhippāya: [Mokkha+adhippāya]  CL=9 One who wants to liberate.
mokkhāma: [Muca+ssama] (kri) CL=7 We are liberated. See - Mokkhati-(2).
mokkhāvahasammata: [Mokkhāvaha+sammata] (ti) CL=7 That should be thought to carry to attain Nibbāna.
mokkhāvaraṇa: [Mokkha+āvaraṇa] (na) CL=7 Blocking Nibbāna. Blocking Magga, Phala, Nibbāna.
molivisesa: [Moli+visesa] (pu) CL=7 The superior state of the crown of the head.
momūha: [Moha+mūha] (pu) CL=7 [Mohamūhoti vattabbe ha-kāralopena "momūho"ti vuttaṃ. Sī, ṭī, saca, 1. 433. Nirutti, nhā. 17.] (1) Very confused. (Ti) (2) One who is very confused.
momūhacittadvaya: [Momūhacitta+dvaya] (na) CL=7 A pair of very confused minds (or) a couple of Momūhacitta.
momūhacittuppāda: [Momūha+cittuppāda] (pu) CL=7 Arising the thought that is confusing. Momūhacitta.
momūhadasaka: [Momūha+dasaka] (na) CL=7 A decade where one may be deluded or confused. (The age between 81 years to 90 years that period is called Momūsadasaka).
momūhadhamma: [Momūha+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 The dhamma or character that is confused.
mona: [Muni+ṇa] (na) CL=7 [Dhāna, ṭī. 429. Saṃ, ṭṭha, 1. 25. Mona+ṇa. Ma, ṭṭha, 3. 69.] (1) Not speaking. Silent being. (2) Knows the Four Noble Truths. The wisdom that insights the Four Noble Truths. Magga wisdom. (Ti) (3) One who is fulfilled with Magga"s wisdom.
monadhamma: [Mona+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 (Ottappa) dhamma which is related to wisdom.
monamagga: [Mona+magga] (pu) CL=7 A cause of wisdom. The path of wisdom.
monapatha: [Mona+patha]  CL=7 The path of wisdom (monapatha) refers to arahattamagga (the path to arahantship) and arahattaphala (the fruition of arahantship), which are considered aspects of mona (tranquility or insight). These are associated with the bodhipakkhiya dhammas (the factors conducive to enlightenment).
monapatta: [Mona+patta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who has wisdom. (2) One who is a silent person.
monappatta: [Mona+patta] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who has wisdom. (2) One who is a silent person.
moneyya: [Muni+ṇeyya] (na) CL=7 [Moneyya+a.] The practice of becoming a monk. The practice is attained sainthood. Magga wisdom. (In Aṃ, 1. Mranamāprana translated as a wise man).
moneyyadhammasamannāgama: [Moneyyadhamma+samannāgama] (pu) CL=7 Fulfilled with the practice of attainment of sainthood.
moneyyadhammasamannāgata: [Moneyyadhamma+samannāgata] (ti) CL=7 One who is fulfilled with the practice of attainment of sainthood.
moneyyadhammaṭṭha: [Moneyyadhamma+ṭhā+a] (ti) CL=7 One who is living with the practice of the attainment of sainthood.
moneyyaguṇayutta: [Moneyyaguṇa+yutta] (ti) CL=7 Yoking with the quality of the practice of sainthood. One who has the quality of the practice of sainthood.
moneyyakolāhala: [Moneyya+kolāhala] (na) CL=7 There is a noisy crowd that will appear a person who will ask about the practice of sainthood.
moneyyamuni: [Moneyya+muni] (pu) CL=7 A Bhikkhu who practiced the practice of sainthood.
moneyyapaṭipadā: [Moneyya+paṭipadā] (thī) CL=7 The path of practice of sainthood.
moneyyapaṭipadādhamma: [Moneyyapaṭipadā+dhamma] (pu) CL=7 The dhamma that is the path of practice of sainthood.
moneyyapaṭipadāparidīpaka: [Moneyyapaṭipadā+paridīpaka] (ti) CL=7 Explaining the path of practice of sainthood.
moneyyapaṭipadāpūraṇa: [Moneyyapaṭipadā+pūraṇa] (na) CL=7 Fulfilling the practice of sainthood.
moneyyappatti: [Moneyya+patti] (thī) CL=7 Attained Magga wisdom. See - Moneyyapaṭipadā.
moneyyappaṭipadā: [Moneyya+paṭipadā] (thī) CL=7 The practice of sainthood. See - Moneyya.
moneyyasamannāgama: [Moneyya+samannāgama] (pu) CL=7 Fulfilled with the practice of sainthood.
moneyyasampanna: [Moneyya+sampanna] (ti) CL=7 One who is fulfilled with the practice of sainthood.
moneyyasampatti: [Moneyya+sampatti] (thī) CL=7 Fulfilled with the practice of sainthood.
monissaṃ: [Muna+nā+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 251.] I will understand. See - Munāti-(2).
mora: [Mura+ṇa] (pu) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.634. Mī+ora. Mayati hiṃsatīti moro. Moga, 7. 174. In Thī morī, morinī.] Peacock.
moracchāpa: [Mora+chāpa] (pu) CL=7 [In Thī  moracchāpikā.] A young peacock.
moracchāpikā: [Mora+chāpikā] (thī) CL=7 A young female peacock. See - Moracchāpa.
morachada: [Mora+chada] (pu) CL=7 The feather of a peacock.
moragīvarājavaṇṇa: [Moragīvā+rājavaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The bright appearance that is like the feather of the neck of a peacock.
moragīvasamānavaṇṇa: [Moragīvasamāna+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 One whose appearance is like the neck of a peacock.
moragīvavaṇṇa: [Moragīvā+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The appearance is like the neck of a peacock.
moragū: [Mora+gamu+rū] (pu) CL=7 A grass that is a kind of reed used to weave a mat.
moragūtiṇa: [Moragū+tiṇa] (na) CL=7 A grass that is a kind of reed used to weave a mat.
morahattha: [Mora+hattha] (pu) CL=7 The peacock"s feather. A manual fan made of the feathers of a peacock. A bundle of the tail"s feathers of a peacock. A fan of the feathers of a peacock.
morahatthaka: [Morahattha+ka] (pu) CL=7 (A) Peacock"s feathers. A bundle of the tail"s feathers of a peacock. (In S ī,ṭī,saca, Sya- translated as the hand of a peacock). (B) The special fan that is made of the bundles of the tails (feathers) of a peacock.
morajika: [Muraja+ṇika] (ti) CL=7 One who worships by striking a small drum with tapering ends.
morajikavatthu: [Morajika+vatthu] (na) CL=7 The subject of a person who worships by striking a small drum with tapering ends.
morakalāpa: [Mora+kalāpa] (pu) CL=7 The bundle of the tail"s feather of a peacock.
morakalāpasannibha: [Morakalāpa+sannibha] (ti) CL=7 Liked the tail"s feathers of a peacock.
morakkhaka: [Mora+akkhi+ka]  CL=9 The sound named morakkha, a kind of sound.
morakukkuṭikā: [Mora+kukkuṭikā] (thī) CL=7 A little peacock like a hen.
moranacca: [Mora+nacca] (na) CL=7 Peacock dance or dancing a peacock.
moranivāpa: [Mora+nivāpa] (pu) CL=7 A place to feed the peacocks.
morapekkhita: [Mora+pekkhita] (na) CL=7 The way of a peacock"s seeing.
morapiñcha: [Mora+piñcha] (na) CL=7 (A) Peacock tail"s feather. (B) The bundle of peacock"s tail feathers.
morapiñchahatthaka: [Morapiñcha+hatthaka] (pu) CL=7 The bundle of peacock tail feathers. The fan is made of bundles of peacock tail feathers.
morapiñchakalāpa: [Morapiñcha+kalāpa] (pu) CL=7 The bundle of peacock tail feathers.
morapiñchakalāpadānānumodana: [Morapiñchakalāpadāna+anumodana] (na) CL=7 Rejoicing in the merit of offering the bundle of peacock tail feathers.
morapiñchakalāpamanohara: [Morapiñchakalāpa+manohara] (ti) CL=7 (Bodhi tree) that is attractive as a bundle of peacock tail feathers.
morapiñchamaya: [Morapiñcha+maya] (ti) CL=7 Finished with peacock tail feathers.
morapiñchaparisibbita: [Morapiñcha+paribbita] (ti) CL=7 That is stitched with peacock tail feathers. (In Myanmar translation, that is stitched with the base of peacock tail feathers).
morapiñchapaṭimaṇḍitabījanihattha: [Morapiñchapaṭimaṇḍita+bījanihattha] (pu) CL=7 A fan is decorated with peacock tail feathers.
morapiñchapaṭisibbita: [Morapiñcha+paṭisibbita] (ti) CL=7 That is stitched with peacock tail feathers. (In Myanmar translation, that is stitched with the base of peacock tail feathers).
morapiñchavatti: [Morapiñcha+vatti] (thī) CL=7 The bundle of peacock tail feathers.
morarukkha: [Mora+rukkha] (pu) CL=7 A tree that leaves is like a peacock tail feather.
morasakalisaṇṭhāna: [Morasakali+saṇṭhāna] (ti) CL=7 That is like the appearance of a peacock"s bone.
moravāpīmahādattatthera: [Moravāpī+mahādattatthera] (pu) CL=7 Mahādatta Thera who lived in Moravāpī region.
moravāpīmahādattattheravāda: [Moravāpīmahādattatthera+vāda] (pu) CL=7 The doctrine of Mahādatta Thera who lived in the Moravāpī region.
moravāpīvāsimahādattatthera: [Moravāpivāsi+mahādattatthera] (pu) CL=7 The doctrine of Mahādatta Thera who lived in the Moravāpī region.
morupasevi: [Mora+upasevi]  CL=9 (The lust) that is set up with peacock feathers (vulture feathers, etc.,) as arrow"s feather.
morīmorinī: [Mora+ī] (thī) CL=7 [Mora+inī] A female peacock. See - Mora.
mosalla: [Musala+ṇya] (na) CL=7 (Unwholesome deeds) that is worthy of being slain (with clubs).
mosanapakatika: [Mosana+pakatika] (ti) CL=7 The nature of destruction. See - Mosadhamma.
mosenti: [Musa+ṇe+anti] (kā,kri) CL=7 They confuse. They made to be confusing.
mosetvā: [Musa+ṇe+tvā] (kā,kri,vi) CL=7 Having confused. Having made to be confusing. See - Mosenti.
mosāpana: [Musa+ṇāpe+yu] (na) CL=7 Confusion. Making to be confusing. Stealing by making to be confused.
motabba: [Muna+tabba] (ti) CL=7 (Gandha, Rasa, Phoṭṭhabba) that should be perceived.
motu: [Muna+tu] (pu) CL=7 One who is a perceiver.
moḷi: [Mhula+i.(molī-saṃ).] (thī,) CL=7 (1) Hair coil or knot. (2) Crown of the head. See - Moḷibaddha.
moḷibaddha: [Moḷi+baddha] (ti) CL=7 One who is adorned with a hair knot.
moḷibandha: [Moḷi+bandha] (ti) CL=7 Hair is bound up in a bun.
moḷidhara: [Moḷi+dhara+a] (ti) CL=7 One whose hair is bound up in a bun.
moḷigalla: [Anipphannapāṭipadika] (pu) CL=7 A great novice whose body is strong and fat.
moḷika: [Moḷi+ṇika] (ti) CL=7 One whose hair is bound up in a bun. See - Moḷiyaphagguna.
moḷimaṇippabhābhiseka: [Moḷimaṇippabhā+abhiseka] (pu) CL=7 The coronation is with the crown of the head which is decorated with rubies.
moḷiya: [Moḷi+ṇika.ka-kiu-ya-pru.] (ti) CL=7 One whose hair is bound up in a bun or One who is with a hair bun. See - Moḷiya.
moḷiyamaṇippabhābhiseka: [Moḷiyamaṇippabhā+abhiseka] (pu) CL=7 The coronation is with the crown of the head which is decorated with rubies. See - Moḷimaṇippabhābhiseka.
moḷiyasīvaka: [Moḷiya+sīvaka] (pu) CL=7 A person named Moḷiyasīvaka. See - Moḷiyaphaggana.
mocayisu: [Muca+ṇaya+iṃsu] (kā,kri) CL=7 They released (Saddattha).  They set free (adhippāyattha). See - Mocayati.
moceyyu: [Muca+ṇe+eyyuṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 They will release. See - Moceti-(1).
modata: [Muda+a+taṃ] (kri) CL=7 May he enjoy. See - Modati.
mohandhakāraviddhasaka: [Mohandhakāra+viddhaṃsaka] (ti) CL=7 One who destroys the pitch-black-darkness delusion.
mohasasāra: [Moha+saṃsāra] (pu) CL=7 Cycles in the cycle of life due to delusions.
mohasavattaniya: [Moha+saṃvattaniya] (ti) CL=7 Arisen or caused the delusion.
mohesu: [Muha+ṇe+uṃ] (kā,kri) CL=7 They pretend not to know. See - Moheti-(B).
mohitu: [Muha+tuṃ]  CL=9 to delude, to not know.
monissa: [Muna+nā+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 251.] I will understand. See - Munāti-(2).
